yasalar.ozet: Her parça bir sonrakinin biçimini ister.
yasalar.aciklama: Fiil öbeği dişliler gibi sırayla takılır: zaman · modal · have · be (süreç) · be (edilgen) · ana fiil. Her dişli kendinden sonrakine bir biçim dayatır: modal → yalın fiil, have → V3, süreç be'si → -ing, edilgen be'si → V3. Zaman ve kişi eki yalnız ilk dişliye biner. 12 zaman, edilgen ve kipler ayrı konular değil, aynı makinenin anahtar ayarlarıdır.

ornekler.en: The road has been repaired.
By June I will have finished.
She has been working all day.

yasalar.ozet: Geçmiş biçim zamanı değil, uzaklığı bildirir.
yasalar.aciklama: Dürbünü ters çevir: her şey uzaklaşır. İngilizcede geçmiş biçim üç şeyden uzaklaşır: şimdiden (I lived there), gerçeklikten (If I had a car… · I wish I knew…) ve karşındakinden (Could you help me? · I was wondering…). Bu yüzden 'If I were you' geçmişi anlatmaz; gerçeklikten bir adım uzakta durur.

ornekler.en: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.
I wish I knew the answer.
Could you open the window?

yasalar.ozet: Aktarma, koşul ve wish aynı merdiveni iner.
yasalar.aciklama: Üç basamaklı bir merdiven düşün: şimdi → geçmiş → geçmişin geçmişi (had V3). will → would, can → could. Birinin sözünü aktarırken, koşulu hayale çevirirken ya da 'keşke' derken hep aynı şeyi yaparsın: fiili bir basamak indirirsin. Ayrı ayrı ezberlenen üç konu, aslında tek bir hareket.

ornekler.en: “I am tired.” → She said she was tired.
If I had known, I would have come.
I can't swim. → I wish I could swim.

yasalar.ozet: Perfect bir zaman değil, bir bakış.
yasalar.aciklama: Arabada dikiz aynasına bakmak gibi: bir noktada durursun ve arkaya bakarsın. Nokta şimdiyse has done, geçmişte bir anaysa had done, gelecekte bir anaysa will have done, bir tahminse must have done. have + V3 gördüğün her yerde soru aynıdır: hangi noktadan geriye bakıyorum?

ornekler.en: I have lost my keys.
When I arrived, the film had started.
She must have missed the bus.

yasalar.aciklama: Kertenkele kuyruğunu bırakır, kuyruk yine kıpırdar. be + -ing ve be + V3 öbeklerinde be düşse de kuyruk anlamı taşımaya devam eder: the man (who is) waiting → the man waiting · the car (that was) parked → the car parked · (Being) tired, he slept. -ing kuyruğu 'yapan, süren', V3 kuyruğu 'yapılan, bitmiş' der. Sıfatta da aynı: boring / bored.

ornekler.en: The woman sitting next to me was a nurse.
The windows are cleaned every week.
The film was boring, so I was bored.

yasalar.aciklama: İngilizce cümle bir sahne gibidir: ışık önce bilineni, sonra yeniyi aydınlatır. a/an yeni bir şeyi sahneye çağırır, the onu tanıdık yapar. There is yeni bir şeyi tanıtır; edilgen çatı bilinen nesneyi başa alır; cleft ve fronting ışığı tek bir öğeye çevirir.

ornekler.en: I bought a lamp. The lamp was cheap.
ornekler.tr: a: ilk kez · the: artık biliniyor

ornekler.en: There is a café near the station.
It was Ali who found the keys.

yasalar.ozet: Soru, olumsuz, tag ve devrik aynı anahtarla açılır.
yasalar.aciklama: Her İngilizce cümlenin bir anahtarı vardır: ilk yardımcı fiil (is, have, can, will…). Soru yaparken onu öne alırsın, olumsuzda not'u ona takarsın, kısa cevapta ve tag'de onu tekrar edersin, devrikte yine onu öne çekersin. Cümlede yardımcı fiil yoksa yedek anahtar devreye girer: do / does / did.

ornekler.en: Where are you going?
You've seen it, haven't you?
Never have I seen such a crowd.

yasalar.ozet: Eylemi isim gibi kullanmak için paketle.
yasalar.aciklama: Bir eylemi cümlede isim yerine koymak istersen onu bir kapsüle koyarsın: -ing (Swimming is fun), to + V (I want to leave), that-cümlesi (I think that…), wh-cümlesi (what she said) ya da soyut isim (decision, growth). Kapsülün içi düz cümle sırasıdır; soru sırası kapsüle girmez.

ornekler.en: I enjoy cooking.
Do you know where the station is?
The decision shocked the town.

yasalar.ozet: Miktar, derece, sıklık ve kesinlik aynı cetvelde.
yasalar.aciklama: İngilizce bir sürü kelimeyi cetvel üzerinde sıralar. Miktar: all · most · some · few · none. Derece: -er · the -est · too · enough. Sıklık: always · usually · sometimes · never. Kesinlik: will · must · should · might · can't. Doğru kelimeyi seçmek, cetvelde doğru çentiği bulmaktır.

ornekler.en: There isn't much time.
She must be at home.
I usually walk to work.

yasalar.ozet: at nokta · on yüzey · in kap — zaman da aynı haritayı kullanır.
yasalar.aciklama: Edatlar bir yerin geometrisini çizer: at = nokta, on = yüzey, in = kapalı alan. Zaman bu haritayı ödünç alır: at 5 (nokta), on Monday (gün bir yüzey), in May (ay bir kap). Öbek fiillerin parçacıkları da yön taşır: up = tamamlanma, out = dışarı / yok olma, down = azalma.

ornekler.en: The meeting is on Monday at nine.
Please turn it down.
It depends on the weather.

bolgeler.ozet: Olay ne zaman, ne kadar sürdü, nereden bakılıyor?
Ne kadar eminsin, ne kadar zorunlu?
Kim yaptı önemli değilse, birinin sözünü taşıyorsan.
Kelimeler hangi sırayla dizilir, anahtar nereye gider?
Tanımlık, miktar, sıfat ve isim öbeği.
Hangi fiil neyi ister, hangi edat nereye gider?

konular.ne: Alışkanlık, genel doğru ve program → Present Simple; şu an ya da bu aralar süren, geçici durum → Present Continuous.

ornek: She is working from home this week.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I am going to the gym every day. → ✓ I go to the gym every day. (alışkanlık = Present Simple)

konular.imge: Tiyatro sahnesi: Past Continuous arkada süren dekor, Past Simple sahneye ansızın giren oyuncu.

konular.ne: Geçmişte biten tek olay → Past Simple; o sırada süren arka plan → Past Continuous. Süren olayı kesen olay Past Simple olur.
konular.formul: V2 / did ↔ was/were + V-ing  ·  while + süren  ·  when + kesen
ornek: I was cooking when the phone rang.
We watched a film last night.

V2 bitmiş, şimdiden kopuk bir anı gösterir

konular.tuzak: ✗ I have seen him yesterday. → ✓ I saw him yesterday. (belli geçmiş zamanla Present Perfect olmaz)

konular.tuzak: ✗ I am waiting here for an hour. → ✓ I have been waiting here for an hour. (Türkçe şimdiki zaman → bu yapı)

yasalar.not: had + V3: geçmişteki bir andan geriye bakış

had → been → V-ing

tuzakAyrik.d: I had been waiting for two hours when he came.

konular.formul: had been + V-ing (+ for / since / when)
ornek: He had been working there for ten years when it closed.
Her eyes were red; she had been crying.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I was waiting for two hours when he came. → ✓ I had been waiting for two hours when he came.

konular.imge: Eski fotoğraf ve eski ayakkabı: used to albümdeki artık olmayan sahne; be used to ayağına oturmuş eski ayakkabı.

yasalar.not: used to: artık uzakta kalmış alışkanlık
be used to + V-ing: to edattır, ardından -ing kapsülü gelir

tuzakAyrik.y: I am used to get up early.
tuzakAyrik.d: I am used to getting up early.

konular.ad: Used to · would · be used to
konular.ne: used to + V: eskiden olan, artık olmayan alışkanlık ya da durum. would + V: geçmişte tekrarlanan eylem (durum için değil). be / get used to + V-ing: bir şeye alışkın olmak / alışmak.
konular.formul: used to + V · didn't use to + V · would + V (eylem) · be / get used to + V-ing
ornek: I used to live in Ankara.
I'm used to getting up early.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I am used to get up early. → ✓ I am used to getting up early. (buradaki to bir edat)

yasalar.not: süreç be'si -ing ister; durum fiili sürece girmez

konular.tuzak: ✗ I am wanting a coffee. → ✓ I want a coffee. (want durum fiili)

will (kesin) → going to (kanıtlı) → might (belki): gelecek de bir cetvelde

konular.ad: Future forms — will / going to / present continuous
konular.ne: Anlık karar ya da tahmin: will · önceden plan ya da kanıt: going to · ayarlanmış randevu: present continuous.
konular.formul: will + V  ·  am/is/are going to + V  ·  am/is/are + V-ing (+ zaman)
ornek: Look at the clouds — it's going to rain.

konular.imge: Gelecekte bir tepe: will have done o tepeden geriye bakmak, will be doing o tepede süren bir film.

yasalar.not: will have + V3: gelecekteki bir noktadan geriye bakış

konular.ne: Gelecekteki bir ana kadar bitmiş olacak ya da o anda sürüyor olacak eylem.
konular.formul: will have + V3 (by …)  ·  will be + V-ing (this time tomorrow)

Yarın bu saatte Roma'ya uçuyor olacağım.

konular.ne: must iç zorunluluk, have to dış kural, don't have to gerek yok, mustn't yasak, should tavsiye.
konular.formul: must · have to · don't have to · mustn't · should / ought to
konular.tuzak: ✗ You mustn't come. ('gerek yok' demek istiyorsan) → ✓ You don't have to come.

konular.imge: Dedektif büyüteci: geçmişteki ize bakıp hüküm verirsin — must have (eminim), might have (belki), can't have (imkânsız).

yasalar.not: modal + have + V3: tahminle geçmişe bakış
must have → might have → can't have: geçmişe dair kesinlik

tuzakAyrik.y: You should called me. / should of

sorular.s: The lights are off. They ____ (go) out.
I can't find my wallet. I ____ (leave) it at the café.

sorular.yanlis: You should have call me.
sorular.dogru: You should have called me.

sorular.yanlis: She can't has forgotten.
sorular.dogru: She can't have forgotten.

cevaplar: they must have missed the train
He must have been at home.
sorular.kaynak: I'm sure he was at home. His car was there.

konular.ne: Geçmiş hakkında çıkarım, olasılık ya da pişmanlık.
konular.formul: must have V3 (kesin çıkarım) · might / could have V3 (olasılık) · should have V3 (pişmanlık) · can't have V3
konular.tuzak: ✗ You should called me. / should of → ✓ You should have called me.

konular.imge: Hava durumu: must = %95 güneşli, might = %50 belki, can't = %0.

yasalar.not: kesinlik cetveli: will > must > should > might > can't
her derecedeki modal yalın fiil ister

tuzakAyrik.y: He mustn't be at home. (olasılık)

sorular.s: That ____ be true — he was with me all day!
Take an umbrella. It ____ rain later.

sorular.yanlis: He mustn't be hungry — he has just eaten.
sorular.dogru: He can't be hungry — he has just eaten.

sorular.yanlis: She might comes later.
sorular.dogru: She might come later.

cevaplar: they are bound to win the match

sorular.kaynak: I'm sure she is at work. Her bag is here.

konular.ne: Ne kadar emin olduğunu kiple ölçmek: must ≈ kesin, might ≈ belki, can't ≈ imkânsız.
konular.formul: must (≈ %95) · will probably · may / might / could (≈ %50) · can't (≈ %0) · be bound to · be unlikely to
ornek: She must be at home — the light is on.
konular.tuzak: ✗ He mustn't be at home. (olasılık) → ✓ He can't be at home.

konular.imge: Yumuşak eldiven: kesin hüküm yerine temkinli kelime, itiraza yer bırakır.

yasalar.not: proves → suggests → may suggest: iddia gücü cetveli
it is likely that + cümle: iddia kapsüle konur

tuzakAyrik.y: This proves that… (kesin değilse)

sorular.s: Prices ____ to rise in winter. (eğiliminde)
It ____ that the plan will work, but we are not sure.

sorular.yanlis: This seems be the best option.
sorular.dogru: This seems to be the best option.

sorular.yanlis: The data proves that coffee causes cancer.
sorular.dogru: The data suggests that coffee may cause cancer.

cevaplar: the results appear to support the idea
It is likely that prices will rise.
sorular.kaynak: Prices will rise. (temkinli söyle)

konular.ne: Kesin hüküm yerine ölçülü iddia: görünmek, eğiliminde olmak, muhtemelen.
konular.formul: appear / seem / tend to · may / might · arguably · it is likely that · to some extent
ornek: The results seem to support the idea.
This is arguably the best solution.
Bu, belki de en iyi çözüm.
konular.tuzak: ✗ This proves that… (kesin değilse) → ✓ This suggests that…

konular.imge: İki yol: 1. tip gerçek yol (olabilir), 2. tip dürbünle uzaktan bakılan hayal yolu.

yasalar.not: 2. tipte V2 gerçeklikten uzaklık bildirir
1 → 2: bir basamak geri (rains → rained, will → would)

tuzakAyrik.y: If it will rain…

sorular.s: If I ____ (be) you, I would apologise.
If you heat ice, it ____ .

sorular.yanlis: If I will see her, I will tell her.
sorular.dogru: If I see her, I will tell her.

sorular.yanlis: If I would have a car, I would drive to work.
sorular.dogru: If I had a car, I would drive to work.

cevaplar: what would you do if you lost your job
If I had money, I could buy it.
If I had money, I would buy it.
sorular.kaynak: I don't have money, so I can't buy it.

konular.ne: Olası koşul: If + Present, will. Hayali koşul: If + Past, would.
konular.formul: 1: If + Present, will + V  ·  2: If + V2, would + V
ornek: If it rains, we'll stay in.
If I won the lottery, I would travel.
konular.tuzak: ✗ If it will rain… → ✓ If it rains… (if tarafında will olmaz)

konular.imge: Geçmişe yazılmış mektup: değiştirilemeyen olaya 'öyle olsaydı' diye bakmak — iki kat geri, iki kat uzak.

yasalar.not: 2. tipten bir basamak daha: V2 → had V3, would → would have
had + V3 ve would have + V3: iki taraf da geriye bakar
gerçekleşmemiş geçmiş: hem zamanda hem gerçeklikte uzak

tuzakAyrik.y: If I would have known…

sorular.s: If we ____ (take) a taxi, we wouldn't have been late.
If she had asked me, I ____ (help) her.

sorular.yanlis: If I would have known, I would have come.
sorular.dogru: If I had known, I would have come.

sorular.yanlis: If you had told me, I would helped you.
sorular.dogru: If you had told me, I would have helped you.

cevaplar: if we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed it
If I had studied, I wouldn't have failed the exam.
If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.
sorular.kaynak: I didn't study, so I failed the exam.

konular.ne: Geçmişte olmamış bir durum ve onun olmamış sonucu.
konular.formul: If + had + V3, would have + V3
ornek: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus.
She wouldn't have known if you hadn't told her.
konular.tuzak: ✗ If I would have known… → ✓ If I had known… (if tarafında would olmaz)

konular.imge: İki saatli kol: koşul geçmişte, sonuç şimdide — ya da tersi.

yasalar.not: iki taraf farklı basamakta durabilir
had + V3 tarafı geçmişe bakar
iki taraf da gerçeklikten uzak

tuzakAyrik.not: Sonuç tarafında 'now' varsa would + V gelir, would have + V3 değil.

sorular.s: If he had taken the job, he ____ (live) in London now.
If I had slept well last night, I ____ (not / be) so tired now.

sorular.yanlis: If I had taken the job, I would have lived in London now.
sorular.dogru: If I had taken the job, I would live in London now.

sorular.yanlis: If he was more careful, he wouldn't had the accident.
sorular.dogru: If he were more careful, he wouldn't have had the accident.

cevaplar: if I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now

sorular.talimat: If ile karma koşul: If I had …
cevaplar: If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If I had eaten breakfast, I would not be hungry now.
sorular.kaynak: I didn't eat breakfast. I'm hungry now.

konular.ne: Geçmişteki koşulun şimdiki sonucu ya da şimdiki durumun geçmişteki sonucu.
konular.formul: If + had + V3, would + V (now)  ·  If + V2, would have + V3
ornek: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken.
konular.tuzak: Sonuç tarafında 'now' varsa would + V gelir, would have + V3 değil.

konular.imge: Dilek feneri: wish her zaman bir basamak geriye bakar — şimdi için V2, geçmiş için had V3.

yasalar.not: wish + V2: gerçeklikten uzak dilek
şimdi → V2, geçmiş → had V3: koşulla aynı merdiven

tuzakAyrik.y: I wish I have a car.
tuzakAyrik.d: I wish I had a car.

sorular.s: I wish I ____ (not / say) that yesterday.
I wish it ____ (stop) raining. It's so annoying!

sorular.yanlis: I wish I can speak French.
sorular.dogru: I wish I could speak French.

sorular.yanlis: If only I listened to you yesterday.
sorular.dogru: If only I had listened to you yesterday.

cevaplar: I would rather stay at home tonight
I wish I knew her number.
sorular.kaynak: I don't know her number.

konular.ne: Şimdiki pişmanlık geçmişle, geçmiş pişmanlık past perfect ile söylenir.
konular.formul: wish + V2 (şimdi) · wish + had V3 (geçmiş) · wish + would (başkasının davranışı) · would rather + V
ornek: I wish I had more time.
Bu akşam evde kalmayı tercih ederim.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I wish I have a car. → ✓ I wish I had a car.

konular.imge: Sahne değişimi: edilgende ışık yapılan şeye döner, yapan karanlıkta kalır (by … isteğe bağlı).

yasalar.not: edilgen be'si V3 ister ve zamanı taşır: is made · was made · has been made
V3 kuyruğu 'yapılan' der
bilinen nesne başa geçer; yapan önemli değilse düşer

tuzakAyrik.y: The accident was happened.

parcalar.a: be: sonrakini -ing ya da V3 yapar

parcalar.m: is made / was made / has been made / will be made

sorular.s: The windows ____ (clean) every week.
This house ____ (build) in 1920.

sorular.yanlis: English is speak in many countries.
sorular.dogru: English is spoken in many countries.

sorular.yanlis: The letter has sent yesterday.
sorular.dogru: The letter was sent yesterday.

cevaplar: the results will be announced tomorrow
My bike was stolen last night.
sorular.kaynak: Someone stole my bike last night.

konular.ne: Eylemi yapan değil, eylemden etkilenen öne çıkar; be zamana göre çekilir.
konular.formul: be (zamana göre) + V3 (+ by …): is made · was made · has been made · will be made
ornek: The results will be announced tomorrow.
konular.tuzak: ✗ The accident was happened. → ✓ The accident happened. (geçişsiz fiil edilgen olmaz)

konular.imge: Kapsülün içinde edilgen: to be done / being done — yapılmayı isteyen ya da sevmeyen özne.

yasalar.not: to be / being + V3: edilgen be'si yine V3 ister
edilgen eylem -ing ya da to kapsülüne girer

tuzakAyrik.y: I want to invite to the party.
tuzakAyrik.d: I want to be invited to the party.

sorular.s: Nobody likes ____ (tell) what to do.
The report has ____ (finish) by Friday.

sorular.yanlis: I don't like being call by my surname.
sorular.dogru: I don't like being called by my surname.

sorular.yanlis: She expects to promote this year.
sorular.dogru: She expects to be promoted this year.

cevaplar: nobody likes being told what to do

sorular.kaynak: They might cancel the concert.

konular.ne: Mastar ya da -ing edilgen olur: to be done, being done; söylenti kalıbı: is said to be.
konular.formul: to be + V3  ·  being + V3  ·  is said / thought / believed + to be
ornek: The house is said to be haunted.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I want to invite to the party. → ✓ I want to be invited to the party.

konular.imge: Söylenti panosu: 'It is said…' kimin söylediğini değil, söylentinin kendisini panoya asar.

yasalar.not: It is said that + cümle: söylenti that kapsülünde
is said to have + V3: söylenen olay geçmişte
is said to → yalın fiil / to have + V3

tuzakAyrik.y: It is said him to be rich.
tuzakAyrik.d: He is said to be rich. / It is said that he is rich.

parcalar.m: It is said / believed / thought that …

sorular.s: The thief is believed ____ (escape) through the window.
It ____ that the company will close.

sorular.yanlis: He is said to be left the country.
sorular.dogru: He is said to have left the country.

sorular.yanlis: It is believed him to be dangerous.
sorular.dogru: He is believed to be dangerous.

cevaplar: the painting is thought to be fake
She is said to be very rich.
sorular.kaynak: People say that she is very rich.

konular.ne: Kaynağı belirtmeden söylenti ya da kanaat aktarmak.
konular.formul: It is said / believed / thought that …  ·  Özne + is said to + V / to have + V3
ornek: It is believed that the painting is fake.
He is thought to have left the country.
konular.tuzak: ✗ It is said him to be rich. → ✓ He is said to be rich. / It is said that he is rich.

konular.imge: Kumanda: düğmeye sen basarsın, işi başkası yapar; nesne ortada, V3 işin yapıldığını söyler.

yasalar.not: V3 kuyruğu 'yapılan' der: nesne yapılır
have zamanı taşır; nesneden sonra V3 gelir

tuzakAyrik.y: I cut my hair at the barber's. (kendin kesmediysen)
tuzakAyrik.d: I had my hair cut at the barber's.

sorular.s: I'm going to have my eyes ____ (test).
She ____ her kitchen painted last month.

sorular.yanlis: I need to have my car repair.
sorular.dogru: I need to have my car repaired.

sorular.yanlis: We had cleaned the windows by a company.
sorular.dogru: We had the windows cleaned by a company.

cevaplar: where do you get your hair cut
I have my car checked every year.
I get my car checked every year.
sorular.kaynak: A mechanic checks my car every year.

konular.ne: Bir işi başkasına yaptırdığında: have / get + nesne + V3. Türkçedeki '-tır / -dır' eki İngilizcede bu kalıba döner.
konular.formul: have / get + nesne + V3  ·  have + kişi + yalın fiil  ·  get + kişi + to V
ornek: I had my hair cut yesterday.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I cut my hair at the barber's. (kendin kesmediysen) → ✓ I had my hair cut at the barber's.

konular.imge: Merdivenden inen söz: tırnak içinden çıkan her fiil bir basamak aşağı iner.

yasalar.not: am → was, will → would, have done → had done
aktarılan söz that kapsülüne girer, sırası düzdür

tuzakAyrik.y: He said me that…
tuzakAyrik.d: He told me that… / He said that…

sorular.s: "I am busy." → She said she ____ busy.
“I will help you.” → He said he ____ help me.

sorular.yanlis: She said me that she was tired.
sorular.dogru: She told me that she was tired.

sorular.yanlis: He asked me where did I live.
sorular.dogru: He asked me where I lived.

cevaplar: she told me she had lost her phone
Ali said that he couldn't come.
Ali said he could not come.
sorular.kaynak: “I can't come,” Ali said.

konular.ne: Başkasının sözü aktarılırken zaman genelde bir adım geriye kayar.
konular.formul: said (that) + özne + bir adım geri zaman  ·  told + kişi + (that)  ·  asked if/wh-
ornek: He told me he had finished.
konular.tuzak: ✗ He said me that… → ✓ He told me that… / He said that… (say'den sonra kişi gelmez)

konular.imge: Ton taşıyan fiiller: said düz bir çizgi, admitted eğik bir baş, denied havaya kalkan bir el.

yasalar.not: deny + V-ing · advise + kişi + to V · admit + that: her fiil kendi kapsülünü ister
aktarma fiilinden sonra da zaman bir basamak iner

tuzakAyrik.y: He suggested me to go.
tuzakAyrik.d: He suggested that I go / suggested going.

sorular.s: She denied ____ (take) the money.
He admitted ____ (break) the window.

sorular.yanlis: She advised me waiting.
sorular.dogru: She advised me to wait.

sorular.yanlis: They denied to steal the car.
sorular.dogru: They denied stealing the car.

cevaplar: the doctor advised him to stop smoking
She offered to help me with the project.
sorular.kaynak: “I'll help you with the project,” she said to me.

konular.ne: say / tell yerine tutumu taşıyan fiil; her birinin kendi kalıbı var.
konular.formul: claim / argue / admit + that · deny + V-ing · advise / urge + kişi + to V · suggest + V-ing / that
konular.tuzak: ✗ He suggested me to go. → ✓ He suggested that I go / suggested going.

konular.imge: Paketli soru: soruyu bir kibarlık kutusuna koyunca içi düz cümleye döner — soruyu kutu taşır.

yasalar.not: wh- / if kapsülünün içi düz sıra
anahtar öne geçmez; do / does düşer

tuzakAyrik.y: Can you tell me where is the bank?

parcalar.m: Can you tell me / Do you know / I wonder

sorular.s: Could you tell me what time ____? (the train / leave)
Do you know where ____ ?

sorular.yanlis: I wonder what time does the shop open.
sorular.dogru: I wonder what time the shop opens.

sorular.yanlis: Do you know if is he coming?
sorular.dogru: Do you know if he is coming?

cevaplar: could you tell me how much this costs

sorular.talimat: Excuse me, could you tell me … ile
cevaplar: Excuse me, could you tell me where the toilet is?
sorular.kaynak: Where is the toilet?

konular.ne: Kibar soruda iç soru düz cümle sırasına döner; do/does/did düşer.
konular.formul: Can you tell me / Do you know / I wonder + wh- / if + özne + fiil
ornek: Do you know where the station is?
I wonder if she will come.
konular.tuzak: ✗ Can you tell me where is the bank? → ✓ …where the bank is?

konular.imge: Tren: lokomotif özne, hemen arkasında fiil vagonu, sonra nesne; yer ve zaman en sondaki yük vagonları.

yasalar.not: yeni bilgi sona: yer ve zaman cümlenin kuyruğunda
özne ile fiil yapışıktır; araya nesne girmez

tuzakAyrik.y: I every morning coffee drink.

sorular.s: We ____ last summer. (Italy / visited)
He ____ in the evening. (the dishes / washes)

sorular.yanlis: I English very much like.
sorular.dogru: I like English very much.

sorular.yanlis: She speaks very well English.
sorular.dogru: She speaks English very well.

cevaplar: we had dinner at a small restaurant last night
last night we had dinner at a small restaurant

sorular.talimat: İngilizce kur: özne + fiil + nesne + yer + zaman
cevaplar: I read my book in the park yesterday.
Yesterday I read my book in the park.
sorular.kaynak: Ben dün parkta kitabımı okudum.

konular.ad: Word order — S V O · yer · zaman
konular.ne: İngilizce cümle Özne + Fiil + Nesne sırasıyla kurulur; ardından yer, sonra zaman gelir. Türkçedeki gibi fiil sona gitmez.
konular.formul: Özne + Fiil + Nesne + Yer + Zaman  ·  (zaman başa da gelebilir)
ornek: I met Ali at the station yesterday.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I every morning coffee drink. → ✓ I drink coffee every morning. (fiil nesneden önce)

konular.imge: Küçük bayrak: sıklık zarfı ana fiilin önüne dikilir, ama be'nin ve yardımcı fiilin arkasında durur.

yasalar.not: always → usually → sometimes → never: sıklık cetveli
zarf anahtarın (be / yardımcı) arkasına geçer

tuzakAyrik.y: I go always to the gym.
tuzakAyrik.d: I always go to the gym.

sorular.s: He ____ breakfast. (never / eats)
They ____ at home on Sundays.

sorular.yanlis: She drives very careful.
sorular.dogru: She drives very carefully.

sorular.yanlis: I have seen never this film.
sorular.dogru: I have never seen this film.

cevaplar: we often go to the beach in summer
in summer we often go to the beach
I sometimes go to the cinema.
Sometimes I go to the cinema.
sorular.kaynak: I go to the cinema. (sometimes)

konular.ne: always, usually, often, sometimes, never ana fiilden önce; be fiilinden ve yardımcı fiilden sonra gelir. Tarz zarfı (carefully, well) nesneden sonra gelir.
konular.formul: özne + always + ana fiil  ·  özne + be / yardımcı + always  ·  fiil + nesne + carefully
konular.tuzak: ✗ I go always to the gym. → ✓ I always go to the gym.

konular.imge: Anahtarı kapının önüne koy: yardımcı fiil öne geçer; yoksa yedek anahtar do gelir.

yasalar.not: yardımcı fiil öznenin önüne geçer; yoksa do / does / did
do / does / did gelince ana fiil yalın kalır

tuzakAyrik.y: Where you are going?

sorular.s: What time ____ the shop open on Sundays?
____ she like spicy food?

sorular.yanlis: What you did yesterday?
sorular.dogru: What did you do yesterday?

sorular.yanlis: Who did call you last night?
sorular.dogru: Who called you last night?

cevaplar: how long have you been living here

sorular.kaynak: She works in a hospital.

konular.ne: Yardımcı fiil öznenin önüne geçer; yardımcı yoksa do/does/did gelir. Who/What özneyse devrik yok.
konular.formul: (Wh-) + yardımcı + özne + fiil ?  ·  Who + fiil ? (özne sorusu)
ornek: Where did you park the car?
konular.tuzak: ✗ Where you are going? → ✓ Where are you going? (Türkçe sırası korunmaz)

konular.imge: Yankı: cümlenin anahtarı sonda tersine yankılanır — is → isn't, didn't → did.

yasalar.not: tag yardımcı fiili tekrar eder; yoksa do / does / did
tag yeni bilgi vermez, bilineni onaylatır

tuzakAyrik.y: You like tea, isn't it?
tuzakAyrik.not: Türkçe 'değil mi' her zaman isn't it değildir

sorular.s: They have finished, ____ ?
She can swim, ____ ?

sorular.yanlis: He works here, isn't it?
sorular.dogru: He works here, doesn't he?

sorular.yanlis: You didn't see him, didn't you?
sorular.dogru: You didn't see him, did you?

cevaplar: it's a beautiful day, isn't it

sorular.kaynak: You will come.

konular.ne: Cümlenin sonundaki kısa soru anahtarı (yardımcı fiili) tekrar eder: olumlu cümleye olumsuz tag, olumsuz cümleye olumlu tag.
konular.formul: olumlu cümle, + yardımcı + n't + zamir?  ·  olumsuz cümle, + yardımcı + zamir?
konular.tuzak: ✗ You like tea, isn't it? → ✓ You like tea, don't you? (Türkçe 'değil mi' her zaman isn't it değildir)

konular.imge: Ayna oyunu: karşındakinin anahtarını alır, kendi öznenle tersine koyarsın.

yasalar.not: So / Neither'dan sonra anahtar öznenin önüne geçer
kısa cevap bilineni tekrar etmez, yalnız anahtarı söyler

tuzakAyrik.y: I don't like it. — Me too.

sorular.s: I've been to Rome. — ____ I.
“Did you like the film?” — “Yes, I ____ .”

sorular.yanlis: She is tired. — So I am.
sorular.dogru: She is tired. — So am I.

sorular.yanlis: He didn't go. — Neither I did.
sorular.dogru: He didn't go. — Neither did I.

cevaplar: I can't drive, and neither can my sister

sorular.kaynak: I like coffee. (sen de seviyorsun)

konular.tr: Ben de · Ben de değil · kısa cevap
konular.ne: Katılmak için so (olumlu) ya da neither (olumsuz) + yardımcı + özne; kısa cevapta da yalnız anahtar tekrarlanır: Yes, I do.
konular.formul: So + yardımcı + özne  ·  Neither / Nor + yardımcı + özne  ·  Yes, özne + yardımcı
ornek: I love jazz. — So do I.
I can't swim. — Neither can I.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I don't like it. — Me too. → ✓ Neither do I. / Me neither.

konular.imge: Kapı çarpması: olumsuz zarf başa gelince anahtar öne fırlar — soru sırası, ama soru değil.

yasalar.not: olumsuz zarf + anahtar + özne
olumsuz zarfı başa almak onu sahnenin ortasına koyar

tuzakAyrik.y: Never I have seen…

sorular.s: Rarely ____ he late for work.
Not only ____ he late, he was also rude.

sorular.yanlis: Hardly I had arrived when it started to rain.
sorular.dogru: Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain.

sorular.yanlis: Never I will forget that day.
sorular.dogru: Never will I forget that day.

cevaplar: rarely do we see such talent
Never have I heard such a story.
sorular.kaynak: I have never heard such a story.

konular.ne: Olumsuz ya da kısıtlayıcı zarf başa gelince soru sırası kullanılır.
konular.formul: Never / Rarely / Not only / Hardly + yardımcı + özne + fiil
ornek: Never have I seen such a crowd.
Not only did he lie, he also laughed.
Yalan söylemekle kalmadı, bir de güldü.
konular.tuzak: ✗ Never I have seen… → ✓ Never have I seen…

konular.imge: Spot ışığı: cümleyi ikiye yarar, ışığı tek öğeye tutarsın — It was ALİ who…

yasalar.not: cleft ışığı tek öğeye çevirir
What I need … : wh-kapsülü özne olur

tuzakAyrik.not: Türkçe vurguyu kelime sırasıyla yapar, İngilizce yapıyla: ✓ It was Ali who found them.

parcalar.m: It is / was X that / who …

sorular.s: ____ I like most about her is her honesty.
It was in Paris ____ they first met.

sorular.yanlis: What I need it is a holiday.
sorular.dogru: What I need is a holiday.

sorular.yanlis: It was my brother which broke it.
sorular.dogru: It was my brother who broke it.

cevaplar: what surprised me was his calm voice

sorular.talimat: It was … who ile Ali'yi vurgula
cevaplar: It was Ali who found the keys.
It was Ali that found the keys.
sorular.kaynak: Ali found the keys.

konular.ne: Bir öğeyi vurgulamak için cümleyi ikiye bölmek.
konular.formul: It is / was X that / who …  ·  What I need is …
ornek: It was Ali who found the keys.
What I need is a long holiday.
konular.tuzak: Türkçe vurguyu kelime sırasıyla yapar, İngilizce yapıyla: ✓ It was Ali who found them.

konular.imge: Ünlem gibi do: olumlu cümlede do'yu açıkça söylemek sesini yükseltmektir.

yasalar.not: vurgu için anahtar görünür olur: I do like it
öne alınan öğe sahnenin ışığına çıkar

tuzakAyrik.y: I did called you.

liste: That film I will never forget.

sorular.s: I ____ lock the door — I'm sure!
She ____ look tired, doesn't she?

sorular.yanlis: He did came to the party.
sorular.dogru: He did come to the party.

sorular.yanlis: I does like your idea.
sorular.dogru: I do like your idea.

cevaplar: I do like your new haircut

sorular.kaynak: I locked the door. (emin ol, vurgula)

konular.ne: Vurgu için do / does / did + yalın fiil ya da öğeyi cümle başına almak.
konular.formul: I do like it · She did tell you · That film I will never forget.
ornek: I do like your new haircut.
She did tell you — you forgot.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I did called you. → ✓ I did call you. (do'dan sonra yalın fiil)

konular.imge: Boş sandalye: söylenmiş kelimeyi ikinci kez oturtmazsın; yerine so, one, do koyarsın.

yasalar.not: eksiltilen öbekten geriye anahtar kalır: … and so can she
bilinen tekrarlanmaz, yalnız yeni söylenir

tuzakAyrik.y: Yes, I think.

liste: I can swim and so can she
I think so / I hope not

sorular.s: "Will it rain?" — "I hope ____."
I don't have a pen. Can you lend me ____ ?

sorular.yanlis: I wanted to call her, but I couldn't call.
sorular.dogru: I wanted to call her, but I couldn't.

sorular.yanlis: These shoes are too small. I need bigger one.
sorular.dogru: These shoes are too small. I need bigger ones.

cevaplar: she can speak French and so can I
I like the red shirt more than the blue one.
sorular.kaynak: I like the red shirt more than the blue shirt.

konular.ne: Tekrarı atmak ya da so / one / do ile yerine koymak.
konular.formul: I can swim and so can she · one / ones · do so · I think so / I hope not
ornek: I wanted to go, but I couldn't.
This cup is dirty — can I have a clean one?
Bu fincan kirli, temiz bir tane alabilir miyim?
konular.tuzak: ✗ Yes, I think. → ✓ Yes, I think so.

konular.imge: Ek vagon: ilgi cümleciği ismin arkasına takılır; virgülsüzse ismi tanımlar, virgüllüyse yalnız ek bilgi taşır.

yasalar.not: virgülsüz cümlecik hangi ismin kastedildiğini aydınlatır
who is / which was düşünce kuyruk kalır (kısaltma)

tuzakAyrik.y: The man who I met him…

sorular.s: This is the café ____ we first met.
The woman ____ car was stolen called the police.

sorular.yanlis: This is the book who I told you about.
sorular.dogru: This is the book which I told you about.

sorular.yanlis: My father, that lives in Izmir, is a teacher.
sorular.dogru: My father, who lives in Izmir, is a teacher.

cevaplar: the book that you lent me was great
I have a friend who speaks five languages.
I have a friend that speaks five languages.
sorular.kaynak: I have a friend. She speaks five languages.

konular.ne: Tanımlayan cümlecik virgülsüzdür ve that alabilir; ek bilgi veren virgüllüdür, that almaz.
konular.formul: the man who/that … (virgülsüz)  ·  Ali, who …, (virgüllü)  ·  where / whose / which
ornek: The book that you lent me was great.
My sister, who lives in Izmir, is a doctor.
konular.tuzak: ✗ The man who I met him… → ✓ The man who I met… (zamir tekrar edilmez)

konular.imge: Kertenkele kuyruğu: who is / which was kopar, -ing ya da V3 kuyruğu kıpırdamaya devam eder.

yasalar.not: be düşer: -ing etken, V3 edilgen kuyruk kalır
kısa kuyruk bilgiyi isme sıkıca bağlar

tuzakAyrik.y: Walking home, the rain started.
tuzakAyrik.d: Walking home, I got caught in the rain.

sorular.s: The letters ____ (send) yesterday arrived today.
The man ____ (stand) by the door is my uncle.

sorular.yanlis: The car parking outside is mine.
sorular.dogru: The car parked outside is mine.

sorular.yanlis: People lived near the airport complain about the noise.
sorular.dogru: People living near the airport complain about the noise.

cevaplar: the woman sitting next to me was a nurse
The letters sent yesterday arrived today.
sorular.kaynak: The letters which were sent yesterday arrived today.

konular.ne: who is / which was düşer, -ing ya da V3 kalır; Having + V3 önceki eylemi gösterir.
konular.formul: the man (who is) standing there  ·  the car (which was) parked outside  ·  Having finished, …
ornek: The woman sitting next to me was a nurse.
Built in 1900, the house needs repairs.
konular.tuzak: ✗ Walking home, the rain started. → ✓ Walking home, I got caught in the rain. (iki tarafın öznesi aynı olmalı)

konular.imge: Paket cümle: koca bir cümle tek bir isim gibi paketlenir; özne ya da nesne olur.

yasalar.not: that / wh-cümlesi isim yerine geçer; içi düz sıra
kapsülün içinde anahtar öne geçmez

tuzakAyrik.y: What did she say surprised me.

sorular.s: I can't remember ____ I put my glasses.
____ he said made everyone laugh.

sorular.yanlis: I don't know what does she want.
sorular.dogru: I don't know what she wants.

sorular.yanlis: That he is late it is strange.
sorular.dogru: That he is late is strange.

cevaplar: I can't believe what you just told me

sorular.talimat: I don't know … ile tek cümle
cevaplar: I don't know where she lives.
sorular.kaynak: Where does she live? I don't know.

konular.ne: Bir cümle, başka bir cümlenin öznesi ya da nesnesi olur; wh- cümleciği düz sıradadır.
konular.formul: that + cümle  ·  what / where / why / how + özne + fiil (düz sıra)
ornek: I think that he is right.
konular.tuzak: ✗ What did she say surprised me. → ✓ What she said surprised me.

konular.imge: Ters akıntı: although bir cümleyi, despite bir ismi taşır; ikisi de 'buna rağmen' der.

yasalar.not: despite + isim / V-ing: eylem isim kapsülüne girer
karşıtlık bilinen engeli, ana cümle yeni sonucu söyler

tuzakAyrik.y: Despite it was late · Although…, but…
tuzakAyrik.d: Despite the late hour · Although it was late, …

sorular.s: ____ feeling ill, she went to work.
____ it was cold, we went swimming.

sorular.yanlis: Although it was late, but we kept working.
sorular.dogru: Although it was late, we kept working.

sorular.yanlis: Despite of the rain, we went out.
sorular.dogru: Despite the rain, we went out.

cevaplar: even though he was tired, he finished the job
Despite the rain, we played football.
We played football despite the rain.
sorular.kaynak: It was raining. We played football.

konular.ne: '-e rağmen' ilişkisi: although + cümle, despite + isim / -ing.
konular.formul: although / though / even though + cümle  ·  despite / in spite of + isim / V-ing  ·  while / whereas
ornek: Although it was late, we kept working.
Geç olmasına rağmen çalışmaya devam ettik.
Despite the rain, the match went on.
konular.tuzak: ✗ Despite it was late · Although…, but… → ✓ Despite the late hour · Although it was late, …

konular.imge: Yol tabelaları: however dönüş, therefore düz devam, for instance yan yol.

yasalar.not: bağlayıcı okuyucuya sıradaki yönü önceden gösterir

tuzakAyrik.y: However the plan is cheap, it is slow.
tuzakAyrik.d: Although the plan is cheap, it is slow.

sorular.s: It was raining. ____, the match went on. (yine de)
The hotel was expensive. ____, the service was poor.

sorular.yanlis: He was ill. Therefore he went to work.
sorular.dogru: He was ill. However, he went to work.

sorular.yanlis: I like tea. In the other hand, my wife likes coffee.
sorular.dogru: I like tea. On the other hand, my wife likes coffee.

cevaplar: as a result, we changed the date

sorular.talimat: As a result ile ikinci cümleyi başlat
cevaplar: The road was closed. As a result, we took another way.
sorular.kaynak: The road was closed. So we took another way.

konular.ne: Cümleler arası ilişkiyi açıkça işaretlemek: ekleme, karşıtlık, sonuç, örnek.
konular.formul: moreover · in addition | however · on the other hand | therefore · as a result | for instance
ornek: The plan is cheap. However, it is slow.
As a result, we changed the date.
konular.tuzak: ✗ However the plan is cheap, it is slow. → ✓ Although the plan is cheap, it is slow.

konular.imge: Ok ve hedef: to + V oku hedefe fırlatır; so that hedefin önüne bir kişi daha yerleştirir.

yasalar.not: to + V kapsülü amacı taşır
so that + can / could → yalın fiil

tuzakAyrik.y: I came here for learn English.
tuzakAyrik.d: I came here to learn English.

sorular.s: She's saving money ____ buy a car.
Speak slowly ____ everyone can understand.

sorular.yanlis: We went to the station for meet our friends.
sorular.dogru: We went to the station to meet our friends.

sorular.yanlis: I study hard so that pass the exam.
sorular.dogru: I study hard to pass the exam.

cevaplar: he took a taxi so that he wouldn't be late
I turned on the light to read.
I turned on the light in order to read.
sorular.kaynak: I turned on the light. I wanted to read.

konular.ad: Purpose — to / in order to / so that
konular.ne: Amaç bildirmek için to + V (ya da in order to + V) kullanılır; özne değişiyorsa ya da modal gerekiyorsa so that + cümle gelir. 'for + V' amaç bildirmez.
konular.formul: to / in order to + V  ·  so that + özne + can / could / will + V  ·  for + isim
ornek: I went to the shop to buy milk.
I left early so that I could catch the bus.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I came here for learn English. → ✓ I came here to learn English.

konular.imge: Sahne: a ilk kez çıkan oyuncu, the herkesin tanıdığı oyuncu, Ø ise tek bir oyuncu değil türün kendisi.

yasalar.not: a yeni bilgi, the bilinen bilgi
a = bir tane: yalnız sayılabilir tekil; çoğul ve sayılamazda düşer

tuzakAyrik.y: The life is short.

sorular.s: She is ____ engineer at ____ hospital near our house.
I saw ____ old man in the park. ____ man was feeding birds.

sorular.yanlis: She plays the guitar and the tennis.
sorular.dogru: She plays the guitar and tennis.

sorular.yanlis: My brother is engineer.
sorular.dogru: My brother is an engineer.

cevaplar: Can you close the window, please
I have a dog. The dog is very friendly.
sorular.kaynak: I have dog. Dog is very friendly.

konular.ne: İlk kez anılan tekil sayılabilir isim → a/an; ikimizin de bildiği → the; genel çoğul ya da sayılamaz → hiçbiri.
konular.formul: a/an + tekil (yeni) · the + bilinen / tek olan · Ø + genel çoğul / sayılamaz
ornek: I bought a lamp. The lamp was cheap.
konular.tuzak: ✗ The life is short. → ✓ Life is short. (genel kavrama the gelmez)

konular.imge: Ansiklopedi ve albüm: genel kavram ansiklopedi maddesi (the yok), belirli olan albümdeki fotoğraf (the var).

yasalar.not: genel kavram sahnede değil, the almaz; belirli olan the alır

tuzakAyrik.y: The nature is beautiful.

sorular.s: ____ education of girls is ____ priority here.
I love ____ music of the 1970s.

sorular.yanlis: The money doesn't make you happy.
sorular.dogru: Money doesn't make you happy.

sorular.yanlis: History of this city is very long.
sorular.dogru: The history of this city is very long.

cevaplar: life is too short to waste
Love is more important than money.
sorular.kaynak: The love is more important than the money.

konular.ne: Genel soyut kavram tanımlıksız; belirli bir yönü the alır; türü genellemek için the + tekil.
konular.formul: Ø Freedom matters · the freedom of the press · The computer changed our lives.
ornek: The history of this town is long.
konular.tuzak: ✗ The nature is beautiful. → ✓ Nature is beautiful.

konular.imge: Elma ve kum: sayılabilenler torbadaki elmalar, tek tek sayılır; sayılamayanlar kum, ancak kovayla (a bucket of) ölçülür.

yasalar.not: sayılamaz isim miktar cetvelinde much / little ile ölçülür
a/an yalnız sayılabilir tekil yeniyi sahneye çağırır

tuzakAyrik.y: informations · advices · furnitures

sorular.s: She gave me a useful piece of ____ .
How ____ luggage do you have?

sorular.yanlis: I need some informations about the course.
sorular.dogru: I need some information about the course.

sorular.yanlis: We bought a new furniture.
sorular.dogru: We bought some new furniture.

cevaplar: could I have a glass of water, please

sorular.talimat: news'i düzelt: I have two pieces …
cevaplar: I have two pieces of news for you.
sorular.kaynak: I have two news for you.

konular.ne: Sayılamayan isimler (water, money, information, advice, furniture) çoğul -s ve a/an almaz; bir parçasını saymak için a piece of, a glass of gibi ölçü kullanılır.
konular.formul: a / an + tekil sayılabilir · -s çoğul  ·  sayılamaz: Ø / some / much + isim · a piece of advice
ornek: Can I give you some advice?
We need two bottles of water.
konular.tuzak: ✗ informations · advices · furnitures → ✓ information · advice · furniture (Türkçede sayılır, İngilizcede sayılmaz)

konular.imge: Kum saati: much ve little kumu, many ve few taneleri ölçer.

yasalar.not: all → most → some → few → none: miktar cetveli

tuzakAyrik.y: much people · informations · every children
tuzakAyrik.d: many people · much information · every child

sorular.s: We don't have ____ milk left. (much / many)
There are only ____ people in the room — maybe three.

sorular.yanlis: How many money do you have?
sorular.dogru: How much money do you have?

sorular.yanlis: Every students has a laptop.
sorular.dogru: Every student has a laptop.

cevaplar: I have a few friends here.
sorular.kaynak: I have some friends here, but not many.

konular.ne: Sayılamaza much / little, sayılabilir çoğula many / few; olumluda some, olumsuz ve soruda any; each / every + tekil.
konular.formul: much / little + sayılamaz  ·  many / few + çoğul  ·  some / any  ·  a lot of  ·  each / every + tekil
konular.tuzak: ✗ much people · informations · every children → ✓ many people · much information · every child

konular.imge: Beş kılık: aynı kişi I · me · my · mine · myself olur; hangi kılık giyileceğini cümledeki görev seçer.

yasalar.not: zamir bilinen birini işaret eder; ilk kez anılan kişi için zamir kullanılmaz

tuzakAyrik.y: My sister and his husband…

sorular.s: Is this your pen or ____ ? (benimki)
My brother lives in London with ____ wife.

sorular.yanlis: Me and my friend went to the cinema.
sorular.dogru: My friend and I went to the cinema.

sorular.yanlis: This is the car of my father.
sorular.dogru: This is my father's car.

cevaplar: they enjoyed themselves at the party

sorular.kaynak: This book belongs to me.

konular.ne: Özne zamiri (I, he), nesne zamiri (me, him), iyelik sıfatı (my, his + isim), iyelik zamiri (mine — tek başına) ve dönüşlü zamir (myself) ayrı görev yapar. he / she ayrımı Türkçede yok; dikkat ister.
konular.formul: I · me · my · mine · myself  ·  he · him · his · his · himself  ·  she · her · her · hers · herself
ornek: This bag is mine, not hers.
konular.tuzak: ✗ My sister and his husband… → ✓ My sister and her husband… (kadın için her)

konular.imge: Kapı zili: there is yeni misafiri içeri alır; içeri girince adı it ya da they olur.

yasalar.not: there is yeni bilgiyi cümlenin sonuna, ışığın düştüğü yere koyar
soru ve olumsuzda anahtar is / are'dir: Is there…?

tuzakAyrik.y: In my city has a big park.
tuzakAyrik.d: In my city there is a big park.
tuzakAyrik.not: ya da: My city has a big park.

sorular.s: ____ any milk in the fridge?
____ too many people here. Let's go.

sorular.yanlis: It has a lot of traffic in Istanbul.
sorular.dogru: There is a lot of traffic in Istanbul.

sorular.yanlis: There is many shops in this street.
sorular.dogru: There are many shops in this street.

cevaplar: is there a bank near here
There is a letter on the table.
There's a letter on the table.
sorular.kaynak: Masada bir mektup var.

konular.ne: Bir şeyin var olduğunu ilk kez söylerken there is / there are kullanılır; 'have' kullanılmaz. Daha önce anılan şey için it / they gelir.
konular.formul: There is + tekil / sayılamaz  ·  There are + çoğul  ·  sonra: it / they
ornek: There is a café near the station. It is very small.
İstasyonun yanında bir kafe var. Çok küçük.
There are two problems with this plan.
konular.tuzak: ✗ In my city has a big park. → ✓ In my city there is a big park. (ya da: My city has a big park.)

konular.imge: Podyum: -er bir basamak yukarı, the -est en tepe; uzun sıfat merdiveni more ile çıkar.

yasalar.not: derece cetveli: as … as → -er → the -est

tuzakAyrik.y: more easier / more better

sorular.s: Her flat is ____ (big) than mine.
This is ____ (good) pizza I have ever eaten.

sorular.yanlis: My car is more fast than yours.
sorular.dogru: My car is faster than yours.

sorular.yanlis: She is as tall than her brother.
sorular.dogru: She is as tall as her brother.

sorular.kaynak: Ali is 180 cm. Can is 175 cm.

konular.ne: İki şey: -er than / more … than; grubun en'i: the -est / the most; eşitlik: as … as.
konular.formul: kısa sıfat: -er than / the -est  ·  uzun sıfat: more / the most + sıfat  ·  as … as
ornek: This road is shorter than the old one.
It was the most difficult day of the week.
konular.tuzak: ✗ more easier / more better → ✓ easier / better

konular.imge: Yayıcı ve alıcı: film sıkıcılığı yayar (boring), sen alırsın (bored).

yasalar.not: -ing kuyruğu etkiyi yayan, -ed (V3) kuyruğu etkilenen
görüş → boyut → yaş → renk → malzeme: sıfatların sabit cetveli

tuzakAyrik.y: I am boring in this class.
tuzakAyrik.d: I am bored in this class.
tuzakAyrik.not: boring dersen sıkıcı olan sen olursun

parcalar.m: görüş · boyut · yaş · şekil · renk · köken · malzeme

sorular.s: The news was ____ . Everyone was shocked. (surprise)
I was very ____ by her story. (interest)

sorular.yanlis: She bought a red big bag.
sorular.dogru: She bought a big red bag.

sorular.yanlis: The film was so excited!
sorular.dogru: The film was so exciting!

cevaplar: he has a lovely little black cat

sorular.talimat: -ing / -ed ile: The trip was … and I was …
cevaplar: The trip was tiring and I was tired.
sorular.kaynak: The trip made me tired. It was long.

konular.ne: Birden çok sıfat genellikle görüş → boyut → yaş → şekil → renk → köken → malzeme sırasıyla dizilir. -ing sıfatı bir şeyin etkisini, -ed sıfatı insanın duygusunu anlatır.
konular.formul: görüş · boyut · yaş · şekil · renk · köken · malzeme + isim  ·  boring (veren) ↔ bored (hisseden)
ornek: The lesson was boring, so I was bored.
konular.tuzak: ✗ I am boring in this class. → ✓ I am bored in this class. (boring dersen sıkıcı olan sen olursun)

konular.imge: Bardak çizgisi: enough tam çizgide, too taşmış; so ve such bardağı gösterip 'o kadar dolu ki' der.

yasalar.not: yeterince → fazla: derece cetvelinde iki çentik
too … to V: sonuç to kapsülünde

tuzakAyrik.y: He is enough old to drive.
tuzakAyrik.d: He is old enough to drive.

sorular.s: The box was ____ heavy for me to carry.
We don't have ____ chairs for everyone.

sorular.yanlis: It was so a good film.
sorular.dogru: It was such a good film.

sorular.yanlis: She's too young for drive.
sorular.dogru: She's too young to drive.

cevaplar: the room wasn't big enough for all of us
The tea is too hot to drink.
sorular.kaynak: The tea is very hot. I can't drink it.

konular.ne: too + sıfat 'gereğinden fazla' (olumsuz sonuç), sıfat + enough 'yeterince'; enough isimden önce gelir. so + sıfat, such + (a) + sıfat + isim 'o kadar … ki' der.
konular.formul: too + sıfat (+ to V)  ·  sıfat + enough  ·  enough + isim  ·  so + sıfat · such a + sıfat + isim (+ that)
ornek: This coffee is too hot to drink.
It was such a nice day that we went out.
